She appears from the left, her short silver-white hair flashing, and snaps her two curved icy daggers into a cross guard; the blade collision detonates an explosion of orange sparks and a ground-shockwave that flips and cracks the flagstones beneath them. She skids backward several meters on her boots, stone chips flying. Without a pause, <Subject 1> pushes forward in a relentless lava charge, his armor cracks flaring brighter; mid-slide <Subject 2> flicks her right dagger upward in a counter-lash aimed at his wrist. He twists the hilt to bat it away and drives his left fist straight at her face; she tilts her head aside, left dagger snaking around to tangle his sword hilt while her right dagger stabs toward his ribs. He sinks his elbow to pin the dagger blade flat, then rams his spiked shoulder plate into her torso and launches her backward through the air. <Subject 2> somersaults mid-air, drives the toe of her stiletto boot through a marble pillar for rebound momentum, and launches herself back over the top of <Subject 1>'s head with both daggers slashing downward. He raises the greatsword horizontally across his chest; the ice-fire impact detonates and shatters the surrounding pillars into flying shards, and he is forced backward, the heels of his boots plowing furrows through the cracked stone. Immediately he spins into a horizontal greatsword sweep; <Subject 2> leaps, their bodies crossing mid-air, and she delivers three consecutive dagger cuts — he parries the first two with the greatsword and deflects the third off the flat of the blade, then snaps a kick into her mechanical frost bracer that sends her flying sideways into a standing section of ruined wall. She pushes off the wall, cracking the stone beneath her boot, dissolves into a fleeting ice-mist afterimage, and dashes back. <Subject 1> anticipates her line and drives his greatsword vertically into the ground, heaving an entire flagstone slab upward to serve as a shield; <Subject 2>'s dual daggers punch through the raised slab. He bursts through from behind it, the iron hilt of his sword striking her shoulder, follows with a spinning elbow to her ribs, and hooks his gauntleted hand around her mechanical bracer to hurl her skyward. She corrects her posture in mid-air and crosses both daggers in a horizontal slash aimed at his throat; he sidesteps, traps the crossed daggers in the notch of his greatsword, wrenches the blade violently sideways, drives a knee into her abdomen, and unfolds into a spinning flame-explosion greatsword slash. She conjures a translucent ice-mirror barrier; it splinters and shatters under the descending fiery blade, and he follows through with an upward flaming uppercut that blasts her off her feet — she crashes backward through a section of crumbling wall, both daggers tumbling from her hands. <Subject 1> erupts in a final lava charge, and his greatsword stops dead, edge-first, an inch from her throat as she lies slumped against the broken wall rubble. The impact shockwave presses a ring-shaped crater into the flagstones beneath them. The frame slows into a cinematic speed ramp: orange embers and shards of blue ice drift and burst around the motionless combatants, and the image freezes on the final tableau — the fire-lit greatsword pressed to <Subject 2>'s neck, her limbs gone slack, unable to move.
